50726530.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full length recombinant human N-terminal His6/SUMO-tagged eIF4A3 expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) administered for 60 to 120 secs by surface plasmon resonance biosensing assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 5.6 Surface plas: SPR biosensing experiments were performed on BiacoreS200 and a BiacoreT100 instrument equipped with CM7 sensor chips (GE healthcare). Immobilization of eIF4A3 onto CM7 sensor surface was performed following the standard amine coupling procedure according to the manufacturer's instructions. HBS-P + (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% Surfactant P20) supplemented with 1 mM DTT was used as the running buffer for immobilization. Typical immobilization levels ranged from 5000 to 10,000 RUs. All binding experiments were performed in 20 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 0.2 mM TCEP, 0.02% Surfactant P20 (v/v), and 1–2% DMSO (v/v) at 25 °C. Differently concentrated compound solutions (7–10 points) were injected for 60–120 s at a flow rate of 50 μL/min and the dissociation was thereafter followed for up to 120 s. Data processing and analyzing were performed using BiacoreS200 and BiacoreT100 evaluation software (GE healthcare). Sensorgrams were double referenced prior to global fitting the concentration series to 1:1 binding model. Dissociative half-lives t1/2 were calculated from the dissociation rate constants koff (t1/2 = ln2/koff).

The solid line represents the best fitting curve. Right: summary table of the thermodynamic parameters including equilibrium binding constants.
